senses.gloss: (contr. of כְּאֵי זֶה צַד, v. כֵּי) how?, in what manner?, in what respect? B. Kam. II, 1 כ׳ הרגל וכ׳ in what respect is the foot of an animal a constant danger (no forewarning being required to make the owner responsible)? Ib. V, 4 כ׳ משלם וכ׳ how is the value of the embryo assessed? Zeb. V, 3 כ׳ in what manner (is the sprinkling performed)?—
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 3:12">B. Mets. III, 12</cite>; a. v. fr.—
<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Kamma 9:2">Tosef. B. Kam. IX, 2</cite>, a. fr. ed. Zuck. <cite ref="K00516"><he>כֵּיזְצַד</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 4:20">Num. R. s. 4</cite> <he>הא כְּאֵי צַד וכ׳</he> (some ed. <cite ref="K00616"><he>כיצד</he></cite>) how now &c.?
